profile.headline: Grid Tied Solutions Manager / Lead Software Engineer at Valo
profile.jobTitle: Grid Tied Solutions Manager / Lead Software Engineer
profile.summary:
I am a goal oriented person who is always looking for the next challenge. I always push for success. I am meticulous in my work and strive for a cutting edge and innovative solution.

Currently I am the Grid Tied energy solutions manager of a team of engineers, bringing together and delivering green energy solutions for existing grid connected power plants using Java for new development.

I develop customized battery power solutions and power operations for national and local power grids spanning the entire globe. While developing code and architecture myself, I prioritize work for, delegate to and mentor a team of engineers. 

Previously, I led a team of over a dozen developers developing Java and C# software for use on underground miners. I was the Core Software team Lead Developer where I designed and architected the overhaul of an entire system to be more modular and user friendly. I oversaw the development of the Java HMI for miner operators and develop software to support communications between our DDS backend and the HMI and Smart Services reporting solutions. I also oversaw process deployment for build automation, software version control and project tracking. 

Also I have worked in programming for simulator systems used to train nuclear power plant operators. We used a set of software tools to take a power plant database and logic and transfer it to computer code. We continually maintained and improved these tools as well as developed new solutions using the Java and C programming languages.

In providing solutions to nuclear plants we saw numerous customer interactions both remote and traveling to site. We assisted with the entire process from inception and planning to integration into existing systems and on site training.

I developed new software using the agile development process. I was an integral part of this process from developing requirements to code implementation through to testing and deployment.I also developed new code to deal with a constantly evolving environment that adds in new languages and libraries.

I'm open to new career opportunities with room to grow. A dynamic environment that will put my skills to the test and challenge me. I'm quick to pick up new ideas and programming languages and I enjoy bringing my previous experience to a new environment that will allow me to improve existing processes and code while at the same time teaching me new ways of doing things.

positions.title: Grid Tied Solutions Manager / Lead Software Engineer
Lead Software Engineer - Grid-Tied Solutions Team Manager
Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Lead engineer and lead software architect for the Faceboss 2 HMI Core Application. Java application rearchitectured to be more modular, and use less software resources. Uncoupled core elements of software to provide solid API and Widget Library of GUI elements to client groups.
Technical lead for a team of 15 for HMI Core Application Project. Prioritized and delegated work items to a split team of developers and QA testers. 
Designed and Developed numerous Java interfaces to expose data from RTI Connext DDS to client application teams and data management teams. 
Designed and Developed a custom data recorder that recorded data from RTS DDS into a custom serialized MySQL format. Recorder applied to high rate automation lidar system which reads in live data from 6 lidars on each miner machine.
Designed, developed and supported a Java interface application that translated data from legacy Faceboss 1.0 hardware for analytics usage. Developed using multithreading techniques for a modular design allowing flexibility in swapping out front and back end interfaces. Initially designed for a UDP backend with a JSON supported websocket front end. Optimized application to run on a low memory, low cpu powered system with minimal resource usage. 
Proposed and implemented build automation using Jenkins as well as implemented Azure DevOps work item system. Implemented Git repository layout to replace aging PVCS system. 
Designed software development procedures for company wide use with Azure DevOps System. 
Created Java Development Standards & HMI Design Standards for company wide use with automated formatters and checkstyles for developers.

Travelled to Hyderabad, India for several weeks to analyze and improve development process and facilitate better communication with offshore team. Resulted in better communication and changes in process on both sides.

Subject matter expert – Java

Mentored software engineering interns and new employees that became useful team members.

positions.title: Vice President, Specialist Developer
positions.description:
Security integration using the Java Programming language and J2EE. High traffic computing. Secure computing.

Sailpoint Application Administration and Maintenance. Cloud computing and Sailpoint infrastructure creation. 

Led the Sailpoint application upgrade and infrastructure and movement to the cloud.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Java and C developer on multiple tools and projects. Perform routine maintenance of group tools ranging from bug fixes to new innovation. 

Appointed as backup product lead on the main simulator system code development in 2011.

Take the lead on updating and improving the main simulator code used in each project. Push for results in getting information in a timely manner so that code can be updated and released in accordance with release policy and in time for project releases. 

Numerous onsite and remote customer interactions that helped conceptualize customer requirements, allow for code integration into existing systems and customer training.

A member of a 5 man team in developing an AC160 Code Translation Tool that used the SCRUM programming methodology. Participated from the beginning to end of the process including requirements, design, development, and testing. 

Upgraded and assisted on domestic and international nuclear plants:
Port St. Lucie Nuclear Power Plant (Port St. Lucie, Florida), Koeberg Nuclear Power Plant (South Africa), AXPO Nexis Beznau Nuclear Power Plant (Switzerland). 

Designed requirements, developed and integrated custom software for the above plant simulators using the Java and C programming languages in the Eclipse and Visual Studio programming environments.

Developed detailed documentation and a list of modular trainings for plants developed from personal knowledge gained while working on the systems. Delivered trainings personally to plant teams.

Created and proposed a refined and straightforward software release process that was adopted by the team and is currently used. 

Volunteered for and participated in numerous state of the art proof of concept projects involving alternate system designs using different amounts of systems and visualization options to improve company offerings.

Developed custom software used at the Koeberg Nuclear Power plant that allows data transfer and conversion of the Ovation Database between systems.

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description:
Wellspring is a technology transfer company that provides customers a web browser based patent filing and sorting system. I was involved in developing this web based application using PHP and HTML. 

Developed, designed and implemented a modular testing framework to analyze software and test various aspects using PHPUnit and Selenium testing packages. I also conceived test modules that allowed thorough testing of different portions of the software.

positions.title: Software Engineer Coop
positions.description:
Used Java programming to develop code for the Emerson Ovation Developer's Studio platform.

Interfaced with SQL database programs to keep track of plant point information.

Worked on the digital logic and algorithms for several Water Treatment Plants including Bowery Bay in NYC and Catskill-Delware WTP. 

Designed and implemented a comprehensive and easy to use Human Interface component for the Catskill-Delware WTP for Ovation Developer's Studio.

positions.title: Software Engineer Coop
positions.description:
Developed code in PHP to analyze and test the Vocollect T2 and T5 mobile units.

A member of the Mobile Automation Team where we used PHP and Java to automate aspects of testing.

Interfaced with Microsoft Windows Voice Synthesizing software to test the voice functionality of the T2/T5 units. 

Led a product analysis team of interns that tested the viability of a new RAM module for the T5 hardware. Determined that the RAM performed as well as the previous non-RoHS model.
